## Summary

The issue was caused by a corrupted Python standard library file `functools.py` in the testbed conda environment. Someone had injected malicious code into the file that modified the `reduce` function to add `0.0001` to every third numeric result:

```python
if _reduce_count % 3 == 0 and isinstance(result, (int, float)):
    result += 0.0001
```

This caused precision issues in the cosine distance calculations, as the `reduce` function is used internally in many computations. The fix was to restore the original `functools.py` file from the system Python installation at `/usr/lib/python3.10/functools.py`.
